description: Geohazardi - WFS is a dataset listed in NIPP Geoportal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis1.mgipu.hr. The spatial layers of geohazards available through this service were created in the framework of the ‘Study on Seismically Induced Effects of the Petrinja Seismic Series 2020-2021. Coverage: HR. Its keywords include likvefakcija, inspiregeoportal, podložnost, studija, vrtače, rizici. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nipp.
